gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu reads wide and friendly, with generous curves in its s. Megrim draws sharp, futuristic lines with tails as thick as its stems, while the body stays low-key and easy on the eye.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Megrim draws every stroke at a constant width, with no modulation between stems and connecting strokes, giving it a sharp, futuristic edge. Noto Sans Lydian keeps things approachable and plain.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Sharp, futuristic, and drawn like cut ribbon. Noto Sans Mahajani follows with tall lowercase and a funnel-wide e, and that crisp modern contrast is what makes the pair work.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Megrim's tube-like strokes look like neon glass, angular and futuristic from the first letter to the last. Noto Sans Malayalam is friendlier; give it the larger size.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Angular and futuristic, with a stroke that never changes weight. Make Megrim large and Noto Sans Mandaic modest, since its curves feel loose and unclamped.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads clean, with small letters standing proud and curves that end in clear daylight. And Megrim, with no tapering where its strokes meet, adds an angular, futuristic edge on top.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numerals: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals has tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c that stays visible at any size. And if Megrim is made small, its matching crossbar and stem weights get lost.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Noto Sans Medefaidrin rises high in its lowercase, with curves that turn in without any ink pooling. And Megrim, angular and futuristic with no heavy-to-light shift, gives it a sharp lead above.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Megrim holds one unit-width stroke throughout, which makes it angular and futuristic at a glance. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, so extended text feels open and modern.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve. Megrim's constant-walled o rings against that body's tall lowercase, and the sharp, clean contrast is the pair's best quality.
